notes.subject: אפדנו
notes.rationale: אַפֶּדֶן (palace-tent) i stap long Tanakh long dispela ples tasol; ol translation i no gat wanpela tok stret.

notes.subject: tupela
notes.rationale: ימים em i dual — tupela solwara; Tok Pisin i nidim namba bilong skelim.

notes.subject: צבי
notes.rationale: צְבִי i min 'splendor/beauty', olsem 'kaikaiwara' (samting i sore long ai) — KJV 'glorious'.

notes.subject: עד קצו
notes.rationale: 'kamap until end bilong en' — em i min dai bilong king o ples i no klia; JPS 'come to his end'.

notes.subject: wanpela man
notes.rationale: עוזר em i wanpela tok tasol; Tok Pisin i nidim 'man i helpim'.

translation: Na em bai planim ⟨את⟩ ol sel bilong haus manmeri bilong en namel long tupela solwara, long maunten bilong kaikaiwara, olsem holi maunten; na em bai kamap until end bilong en, na i no gat wanpela man i helpim ⟨em⟩.
